title: Theoretical Unary Church Numerals in Production
pattern: Representing natural numbers as nested recursive algebraic unary datatypes in performance-sensitive compiled systems.
why_bad: It is a functional puzzle. While theoretically elegant in dependent type checking, unary algebraic representations trigger $O(N)$ memory allocations and recursive stack dereferences for simple arithmetic operations, causing severe performance bottlenecks.
detection: Recursive enum types wrapping themselves within nested variants to represent numeric quantities.
counterexample: Academic compilers or interactive theorem provers (such as Coq/Idris systems) where structural recursion is mathematically required for correctness proofs. `Context-dependent`.
fix:
Use standard, primitive compiled integers with bounds constraints.
```rust
type Unary = usize;
```
source: *Types and Programming Languages*, Section 5.2 / *Certified Programming with Dependent Types*.
